24.old: Homes are strata-titled under the BC Strata Property Act. Request Form B, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the bylaws (rentals, pets and age restrictions) before removing subjects; 55+ and 45+ complexes enforce age bylaws that apply to at least one occupant.
24.new: A strata-titled home brings the BC Strata Property Act into play. Get the Form B, the bylaws on pets, rentals and age restrictions, the depreciation report and two years of recent strata minutes ahead of removing subjects. Complexes aimed at 55+ and 45+ enforce age bylaws, which at least one occupant has to satisfy.

Ask for the property's flood construction level, lender and insurer requirements, and whether a geotechnical or floodplain covenant is registered on title.
26.new: Portions of Rosedale, Fairfield Island, lower Sardis, Greendale and Yarrow lie inside the floodplain along the Fraser and Vedder Rivers, and protection comes from the City's dike network. Find out what the lender and insurer will want, along with the property's flood construction level, and whether title has a registered covenant, geotechnical or floodplain.

28.old: Schools and transit: Chilliwack is served by School District 33 (SD33) — Sardis Secondary, G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary and a range of elementary catchments including Unsworth, Watson and Vedder. Always confirm catchment with SD33 before buying. BC Transit runs Chilliwack routes along Vedder Road, Luckakuck Way and Young Road, and the Fraser Valley Express (Route 66) links Chilliwack to Abbotsford and Carvolth Exchange in Langley.
28.new: For schools, Chilliwack is part of School District 33 (SD33), where G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary sits among its schools together with Sardis Secondary and Chilliwack Secondary, and elementary catchments include Watson, Vedder and Unsworth. I would confirm the catchment with SD33 first. For transit, BC Transit covers Chilliwack, and Young Road, Luckakuck Way and Vedder Road all have service. Another option is Route 66: the Fraser Valley Express serves Chilliwack, Abbotsford and Carvolth Exchange in Langley.

35.new: Garrison Crossing, Promontory, Vedder Crossing, Sardis South, Sardis East Vedder and Sardis West Vedder are where most Sardis homes are listed. Age, lot size and price vary by area, so before booking showings I suggest narrowing it down to two or three neighbourhoods.

39.new: The BC Strata Property Act covers strata-titled homes like these. If a complex is 55+ or 45+, its age bylaws are enforced, and at least one occupant is subject to them.

43.new: SD33 is the Chilliwack school district. Homes in Sardis and the south side are zoned toward Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham, whereas the north side draws on Chilliwack Secondary. Catchment lines can shift, so contact SD33 about the address you are considering.

45.new: Yes. Local routes run by BC Transit in Chilliwack use Young Road, Vedder Road and Luckakuck Way, while the Fraser Valley Express heads out toward Abbotsford and Langley. Little or no bus service reaches the rural areas of Columbia Valley, Greendale and Ryder Lake.
